name: 役割と個人の権限対象一覧
prompt:
Faithfully recreate only the Japanese role-and-member permission target list shown in the primary native preview. This is a precise reference reconstruction, not a redesign.

Use the exact 390x228 white canvas and follow the native Japanese preview for all copy, geometry, colors, typography and icon placement. At x16 near y12, place the small muted-gray heading 「役割」. Below it, make one compact white selection row with 「全員」 left aligned near x24 in dark charcoal, and a small muted-gray right chevron near x360. Keep the thin light-gray divider at about y92, inset x16 to x374.

Below the divider, place the small muted-gray heading 「メンバー」 at x16 near y124. Add one compact member row: a pale-mint circular 40px avatar near x24 y162 with the dark-green Japanese initial 「山」 centered inside; to its right, show the exact bold dark name 「山田 はるか」 around x80 y163 and the exact smaller muted-gray subtitle 「やまだ・はるか」 around x80 y190. Place a matching small gray right chevron near x360 y184. Preserve the white background and open, compact spacing.

The original source crop is only context for the role/member selection meaning; do not copy its English text, photographic avatar, gray screen background or large rounded cards. Use the native Japanese preview as the exact design authority. This crop contains no hyperlink text: both names/labels are selection rows with chevrons, not blue text links. Keep all row labels dark and metadata gray. Do not add extra role/member rows, buttons, controls, blue text, cards, shadows or screen chrome.
reviewNotes: a001: divider is about 8px low; avatar about 4px too large and 6px left; names around 2px left. No hyperlinks.
